outputs.explanation: Spatial deconvolution plots display per-spot (individual) values as a heatmap over tissue coordinates; this is analogous to a heatmap and does not require additional overlay of individual data points.
This is a box plot (already exempt from requiring individual points) but additionally shows individual data points as scattered dots overlaid on the boxes for each group.
GSEA enrichment plots are line plots depicting a running enrichment score across ranked genes; overlaying individual data points is not applicable and would not be meaningful for this plot type.

The bar chart shows computed log2 fold-change values per gene from a differential gene expression analysis (a single derived statistic per gene, with p-values annotated), rather than a mean of a small number of discrete replicate measurements, so individual data points are not applicable here.
Panel E consists of representative H&E and IHC micrographs, not a quantitative plot, so this check does not apply.
